posts.title: WooCommerce or Shopify?
posts.caption:
WooCommerce or Shopify? The honest answer for small brands 👇

WooCommerce: you own your site and data, no platform fee per sale, full design freedom, and it works for niches other platforms restrict.

Shopify: quick to start and hosting is included, but you pay a monthly plan plus paid apps, and some niches face stricter rules.

If you want control and room to grow, WooCommerce wins. If you sell a few simple products and want zero setup, Shopify can work.

Not sure which fits you? Ask me, link in bio.

posts.title: They added to cart. Then they left.
posts.caption:
They added to cart. Then they left. Here are 5 checkout leaks to fix before the holiday rush 👇

1. Shipping costs show up late: show them on the product page or in the cart
2. You force them to sign up: turn on guest checkout
3. Your form asks too much: keep only what you need to ship and get paid
4. They can't pay their way: offer the methods your buyers already use
5. Checkout breaks on mobile: buy something from your own store on your phone this week

Fix even two of these and more carts turn into orders. All five are quick changes on a WooCommerce store.
